name: Aghorebhyo Atha Ghorebhyo
text:
अघोरेभ्योऽथ घोरेभ्यो घोरघोरतरेभ्यः ।
सर्वेभ्यः सर्वशर्वेभ्यो नमस्ते अस्तु रुद्ररूपेभ्यः ॥
meaning: Salutations to Rudra in all his forms, the gentle and the fierce, and those fiercer still: to every form of Shiva, everywhere.
purpose: One of the five Brahma mantras of Shiva, praising him in fierce and gentle forms alike.
supports: Meeting what frightens us; holding gentleness and fierceness together.
note: The Aghora mantra, from the Mahanarayana Upanishad.
